rationale: The agent successfully authenticated the user using their email address. It then retrieved the user's recent orders and identified the order containing the fleece jacket. Although the exchange could not be processed immediately because the order was pending, the agent informed the customer of this policy and set the expectation for future exchanges. The conversation ended positively, with the agent ensuring that the customer was aware of the next steps. All actions taken by the agent were in line with the defined policies, including not attempting to process an exchange without confirmation and not inventing any information.
